name: Kouzuki Erena
source:
"I've always had a hard time with the way I look. And yet, I can't believe that there are people who tell me they like it..."

A fourth-year student who transferred to Ieva Girls' School. She sees the bright side of things and can act accordingly, but she has a strong core and a surprisingly stubborn side.

She has foreign blood in her veins, and is often worried about people rejecting her for her eyes and hair.

[Translated from [url=https://www.otomate.jp/chouchoujiken/chara/]official website[/url]]
